pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit highly irregular, jagged perimeters with multi-directional star-shaped or leaf-like protrusions. The edge gradients are sharp, showing high contrast between the ochre patch centers and the cream-colored borders. Patch area is dominant relative to the negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous network of intersecting pathways. The topological graph is composed primarily of tri-radial and quad-radial junction nodes. Corridor thickness is generally uniform with slight narrowing at the vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. The profile is composed of discrete, upright hair clusters creating a continuous serrated edge against the background.
